item.title: The Real Solution for Clear Skin – Cole Skincare For Men
item.description: Black men often experience razor bumps due to their thick, coarse hair texture, which can lead to ingrown hairs when shaved too closely. These hairs can re-enter the skin, causing inflammation and scarring. To prevent razor bumps, proper skin preparation is essential. This includes cleansing, gentle exfoliation, and using a warm towel to open pores before applying pre-shave products.
